name: Neon Ultraviolet

prompts.stage: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target is the attached original BandHero game texture. Theme: Neon Ultraviolet: vivid ultraviolet spotlights, icy cyan edge lighting, energetic neon arcade atmosphere. Color palette: background #0C0914, dark surface #141020, primary #A970FF, secondary #7459E8, highlight #36E2FF, off-white text #F5F0FF. Change only the color treatment; preserve all original objects, layout and typography. No new words, objects, logos or watermarks. Preserve original 16:9 composition: dark empty left area for menu, four overhead spotlights and truss, stage instruments on right and floor reflections. Recolor all purple/pink/cyan lighting to theme palette. Cinematic subtle haze, keep the left half very dark. Output 1920x1080.
